articles.title: Bitcoin advocacy group to join US State Department’s ‘digital freedom’ program
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin Policy Institute and three partner organizations will be able to send employees to work alongside State Department officials to address issues including digital freedom.

articles.title: Dem senator calls GOP’s CLARITY ethics proposal a ‘piece of s---’: Politico
articles.snippet: On Wednesday, Senate Republicans released the proposed text for the CLARITY Act, which has been met with pushback from Democrats regarding ethics provisions.

articles.title: Polymarket Account in Farage Backer's Name Took $9M in Crypto From Unknown Sources: FT
articles.snippet: The "GCottrell93" account bet the funds on Trump's election win and cashed out the profit, though who paid in and who collected is unclear.
